sections.heading: Arbaaz Khan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Arbaaz Khan was born on 4 August 1967 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Salim Khan and his mother, Sushila Charak Singh Khan. He is a sibling of Salman Khan, Sohail Khan, Alvira Khan Agnihotri and Arpita Khan.
He studied at Scindia School and St. Stanislaus School.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.
